name: click-to-copy
description: A [ copy ] button under every fenced code block in Claude's replies, with the exact text it will copy beside it. One click puts a shell command on your clipboard as a one-liner, and any other block exactly as written. Also tells Claude to fence commands instead of suggesting the `!` prefix.

oneLine.title: One-liner join
oneLine.description: How a multi-line shell block is flattened before it is copied. and joins its commands with ' && '; semicolon joins them with '; '; off copies every block exactly as written. A block that cannot be joined safely is never joined.

fences.title: Which blocks get a button
fences.description: all draws a button under every fenced block; shell only under blocks tagged bash, sh, zsh, shell, fish or console. Either way, only shell blocks are flattened.

stripPrompt.title: Strip shell prompts
stripPrompt.description: Remove a leading '$ ' or '% ' prompt from each command of a shell block.

promptRule.title: Ask Claude to fence commands
promptRule.description: Add a short system-prompt section telling Claude to put commands you should run yourself in a fenced bash block, one per block, instead of suggesting the `!` prefix. Off leaves the system prompt alone.
